title: Just 3% Of Eligible People Support The Blood Supply
hook: Blood donation eligibility is broad. The donor base isn't.
closing: A stable blood supply depends on turning more eligible people into regular donors.
question: Would you donate blood?

segments.say: Only 3% of eligible people donate blood, leaving the supply dependent on a tiny volunteer pool.
Blood donor volume fell 40%, so fewer people are replacing the regular donors hospitals already rely on.
